universal_patterns.pattern: provisions of this chapter applicable to occupations,?\s+trades,?\s+professions,?\s+and businesses regulated under this title
any regulatory board or commission established under this title

proposal.rationale: Reviewing the undetermined sections: Chapter 541-A is New Hampshire's Administrative Procedure Act (rulemaking), which applies to all state agencies generally — not specifically an occupational licensing umbrella. Its provisions reference "agency" broadly (any state board/commission/department), not occupations/professions. Marking it universal would falsely sweep in all rulemaking procedure sections as occupational licensing rules. Chapter 20-B:1 (orientation for regulatory board members) is similarly general state-government housekeeping, not a substantive licensing scope provision. These are correctly left undetermined — they don't actually establish scope over the practice acts, even though they touch boards. Keeping patterns as-is to avoid false positives.
